events.handoff: Add a cancellation_reason field to the appointment cancellation flow and record the design decision in project storage so it can be retrieved later.

output_document.summary: Plan: add an optional cancellation_reason column (<=500 chars); on PATCH /appointments/<id>/status accept an optional trimmed text reason only when moving to cancelled, reject >500 chars or a reason with a non-cancelled status with 400 (no echo); never include the reason in SMS/email (may contain sensitive detail); AppointmentList.jsx prompts for an optional reason and displays it; add test_cancellation_reason.py and a conftest.py excluding only test_sms.py; record the design decision as decision-008-cancellation-reason after review. UTC code untouched.

events.handoff: Apply the approved cancellation_reason plan to the 5 files; record the design decision via write_entry.

output_document.summary: Applied the change across schema.sql (optional column + commented ALTER TABLE), app.py (validate and save the reason only on a real transition to cancelled, never in SMS/email), AppointmentList.jsx (reason prompt + display), new test_cancellation_reason.py, and conftest.py (exclude only test_sms.py). Recorded the design decision decision-008-cancellation-reason via write_entry and read it back to confirm.

Security review PASS, nothing blocking. Reason stored parameterized, length/type validated with 400 and no echo, and deliberately excluded from SMS/email so free-text patient detail is not leaked. Non-blocking follow-ups: concurrent status writes could overwrite a saved reason; the frontend doesn't enforce the 500-char limit or surface the server's rejection; the new column must be added (ALTER TABLE) before deploy or cancellations 500.
